implemented_requirements.requirement: Player can press a key to flap and keep the bird from falling
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.handle_events() listens for KEYDOWN events (SPACE, UP, W) and calls Bird.flap(); Bird.flap() sets velocity = settings.FLAP_STRENGTH. Bird.update() applies gravity and updates y position.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Gravity makes the bird fall when not flapping
implemented_requirements.evidence: Bird.update() adds settings.GRAVITY to velocity (capped by MAX_FALL_SPEED) and increments self.y.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Randomly generated vertical gaps in pipe pairs appear
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.spawn_pipe() computes gap_center using random.uniform within margins and gap_size from current_gap_size(); creates Pipe with those values. Pipe.__init__ builds top and bottom rects based on gap_center and gap_size.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Each successful pass of a pipe pair increases the score
implemented_requirements.evidence: In Game.update() during PLAYING, for each pipe: if pipe.has_passed(settings.BIRD_X) then self.score += 1. Pipe.has_passed() returns True once when pipe.x + PIPE_WIDTH < bird_x.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Game ends if the bird collides with a pipe
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.update() checks pipe.collides(bird_rect) and calls self.game_over() on collision.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Game ends if the bird hits the ground
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.update() tests if self.bird.y + self.bird.radius >= ground_y; if true, sets bird on ground and calls self.game_over().

implemented_requirements.requirement: Difficulty gradually adjusts by varying gap sizes and pipe speeds
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.difficulty_progress() returns score/DIFFICULTY_RAMP_SCORE. current_gap_size() shrinks with progress; current_speed() increases with progress. These values are used when spawning pipes and updating scroll speed.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Rendering of bird, pipes, background, ground and HUD
implemented_requirements.evidence: Bird.draw() renders a rotated bird; Pipe.draw() renders pipe halves and caps; Game.draw() renders sky, clouds, pipes, ground, bird and HUD text.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Main entry point that starts the game loop
implemented_requirements.evidence: main.py imports Game and calls Game().run() inside a guarded __main__ block; also handles missing pygame with a clear error message.

critical_issues: None observed that prevent core gameplay. All referenced settings attributes exist, and the code paths for flapping, pipe generation, collision, scoring and difficulty are implemented.
judge.summary: The provided source files contain a complete, functional Flappy Bird clone. Core mechanics (flap, gravity, pipe gaps, scoring, collision, ground hit) are implemented, and difficulty ramps by shrinking gaps and increasing pipe speed. The game loop, rendering, and entry point are present, and the code is likely to run correctly given pygame is installed.
